description.value: Cazba Restaurant is a Persian grill serving authentic kebabs, slow-cooked stews, and saffron rice dishes rooted in Iranian culinary tradition. It is part of a growing Metro Vancouver chain with around ten locations, emphasizing fresh ingredients and traditional recipes inspired by the Persian concept of the 'Sofréh' — a shared, welcoming table. The North Vancouver location offers both dine-in reservations and online ordering.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Cazba Restaurant is an active, multi-location Persian grill chain with a North Vancouver restaurant listed among its locations; the North Van phone number +1(604)980-7373 matches OSM exactly. The OSM address of 132 West 16th Street is not confirmed by the website, which lists 1059 Churchill Crescent as the Central Kitchen contact address without giving a separate street address for the North Vancouver restaurant. Online ordering ('Order Now' buttons and a cart system) confirms takeout capability, but no cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM address (132 West 16th Street) is not confirmed by the website. The website contact page lists 1059 Churchill Crescent, North Vancouver as a contact/Central Kitchen address; the North Vancouver restaurant's specific street address is not separately stated, so the OSM address could not be verified.
Website contains placeholder editorial text ('ADD ANYTHING HERE OR JUST REMOVE IT…') on multiple pages, suggesting the site may be partially built out.
Some website subpages (/menu/, /cart/, /blog/) returned Cloudflare rate-limit errors (Error 1015), so full menu details could not be reviewed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, actively operating Persian restaurant with a confirmed phone number, current website, and a recent OSM check date of 2026-03-24. Useful to touring cyclists as a sit-down meal option in North Vancouver.

wow_evidence: growing Metro Vancouver chain with around ten locations
